sentences.text: DATED : 15th APRIL, 2024.
ORAL JUDGMENT .

In this appeal, challenge is to the judgment and award dated 03.09.2013, passed by the learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), Pusad (for short "the Reference Court"), whereby the claim for enhancement of compensation was partly allowed.

02] The factual position in the present appeal is as under:-
Amdapur Irrigation Project, District Yavatmal Date of Notification under Section 4 of the Land 21.08.1997 Acquisition Act, 1894.
 Address of Details of LAO Award Ref. Court  property property Dated Award Dated  27.11.2000 03.09.2013  Village: Kurli, Tq. Gat No.58 & Rs.17,500/- Rs.35,000/-
 Umarkhed, Dist. 60 per hectare per hectare  Yavatmal.

] Learned advocates for the parties submit that this appeal is covered by the decision rendered by this Court in First Appeal No.8/2015 [Ulhas S/o. Hiraman Rathod Vs. The Collector, Yavatmal & Others, on 05.09.2023].
-3- 12A.FA.559.2016.

entities.text: Ulhas S/o. Hiraman Rathod Vs. The Collector, Yavatmal & Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Judgment.odt 04
] Learned advocate for the appellants submits that the land in this appeal and the land in First Appeal No.8/2015 are similarly situated in all respects.
The lands are dry-crop lands.
It is pointed out that the compensation awarded by this Court for dry- crop land in First Appeal No.8/2015 is @ Rs.83,000/- per hectare.

It is seen that, while deciding First Appeal No.8/2015,
number of judgments decided in the first appeals arising out of the award passed in respect of the same project and the same village have been considered.
05] On going through the record and proceedings, I am satisfied that this appeal is covered by the decision rendered in First Appeal No.8/2015.
Accordingly, the appeal deserves to be allowed.

Hence the following order:
a) The appeal is allowed.

b) Respondent No.2-Acquiring Body is directed to pay compensation to the appellants @ Rs.83,000/- (Rupees Eighty Three Thousand Only) per hectare.
Pandurang S/O Kashiram Ade vs The State Of Maharashtra Thorugh ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35672343/
2 c) The remaining part of the impugned order is maintained as it is.
-4- 12A.FA.559.2016.

sentences.text: Judgment.odt d) It is made clear that while calculating the aforesaid amount, interest and other statutory benefits for the period of delay of 656 days caused in filing this appeal, shall not be calculated and granted.
e) The amount of compensation with interest in terms of this order be deposited within ten weeks.
f) Failure to deposit the said amount within stipulated time shall entail serious consequences.

06]
The appeal is disposed of accordingly.
No order as to costs.
Pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
(G. A. SANAP, J.) Vijay Signed by: Mr. Vijay Kumar
